NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 20, 8:48 AM ET

CeeDee Lamb is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate at 20.6 DraftKings points for $8,800, against Tennessee. Amon-Ra St. Brown (17.7, $8,200) and George Pickens (16.5, $6,800) are next.

Tre' Harris returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.73 projected points per $1,000 at $4,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 20, 8:48 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 11

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs TEN ($8,800)

CeeDee Lamb carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.6 DraftKings points at $8,800. That is 3.0 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 30.9 routes. The salary works out to 2.35 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 7.6 and a ceiling of 45.3, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.5 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs TB ($8,200)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 17.7 DraftKings points at $8,200. The model gives him 8.8 targets on 27.9 routes. The salary works out to 2.15 projected points per $1,000, 12th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 17.6 points with a simulated floor of 5.0 and a ceiling of 43.4, and he holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 6-point favorite at home against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 25.75 in a game totaled at 45.5.

George Pickens, DAL vs TEN ($6,800)

George Pickens projects 3rd at the position with 16.5 DraftKings points at $6,800. The model gives him 7.5 targets on 32.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.42 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Pickens averaged 16.5 points with a simulated floor of 4.0 and a ceiling of 42.7, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.5 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Tre' Harris, LAC vs NYJ ($4,000)

Tre' Harris projects for 10.9 DraftKings points at $4,000, which works out to 2.73 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 29 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 4.6 targets on 21.6 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Harris averaged 11.0 points with a simulated floor of 2.8 and a ceiling of 26.8, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Chargers are a 3-point favorite at home against the Jets, with an implied team total of 22.25 in a game totaled at 41.5.
